text: *ST禾信公告，公司此前拟通过发行股份及支付现金方式购买吴明、上海堰岛企业管理合伙企业（有限合伙）等两名交易对方合计持有的上海量羲技术有限公司56.00%股权并募集配套资金暨关联交易。2026年9月29日，上交所重组委审议结果为本次交易符合重组条件和信息披露要求；本次交易尚需经中国证券监督管理委员会同意注册后方可实施。
text_en: *ST Hexin announced that the company had previously planned to purchase, by issuing shares and paying cash, 56.00% equity in Shanghai Liangxi Technology Co., Ltd. held collectively by two counterparties, Wu Ming and Shanghai Yandao Enterprise Management Partnership (Limited Partnership), and to raise matching funds, constituting a related-party transaction. On September 29, 2026, the review result of the Shanghai Stock Exchange M&A Review Committee was that this transaction complies with restructuring conditions and information disclosure requirements; this transaction still needs to be registered with the approval of the China Securities Regulatory Commission before it can be implemented.
